quests.title: A tree, back on the path
quests.ask: Write `plant_tree()`: plant a tree on the robot's cell, then end back on the path where the hedge starts, facing east.
quests.nudge: A tree grows upward. How does the robot get back down to the path afterwards?

quests.title: A hedge, then the gap
quests.ask: Write `plant_hedge()`: plant a hedge starting on the robot's cell, then end where the next tree goes, facing east.
quests.nudge: Look at the Goal view: is there an empty cell between a hedge and the next tree?

quests.title: Trees and hedges to the gate
quests.ask: Use both names to plant the whole path, tree and hedge in turn, and finish at the gate facing east.
quests.nudge: Which two calls make one repeat of the pattern?
